duration.text: The Tourism Management at Chongqing Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. Personal Presentation/Research Plan*2. English language proficiency certificate*3. Physical Examination FormPhotocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)*4. Photocopy of valid passportWith name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included*5. Passport photoA recent passport-sized photo of the applicant*6. High school academic transcriptAcademic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.*7. High school graduate certificateGraduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.*8. Certification of no criminal record*9. ResumeWritten in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: Applicants should be in good health.Age of applicant: no less than 18 years old.English language proficiency certificate.
